capabilities: Generate randomized practice questions from parameterized variables and formulas
Create custom exams from saved questions
Review exam history, grades, and mistakes
Track study progress with tailored exams for weak problems
extras: The plugin description notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the author states it will be actively maintained because they use it for their own studies.
motivation: The author built it for themselves and other engineering students who reach for flashcards or past papers while studying.
problem: Students using Obsidian have to hunt for past papers and external material to test themselves, with no way to generate fresh practice problems from their notes.
summary: Exam generator that creates randomized practice questions with computed answers, custom exams, flashcards, and a study progress overview.
